description:
Built to withstand abuse, the KH20 is a top quality unicycle designed for trials, street, and flatland riding. It has been the preferred unicycle for multiple World Unicycle Trials Champions and multiple top 5 finishers in World flatland and street riding events.

The small wheel and fat tire are nimble and absorb shock, with small rim drill-outs to maximize strength while reducing weight. The KH frame is strong and lightweight with an abundant use of one-piece forged components ensures high strength and durability. It also excels as a durable mountain unicycle for kids.
